findings: Mount capability code compiled only with BLKID and GIO_UNIX. Physical scheduling/probing claims do not transfer to all platforms.
Reflink capability assumes btrfs/ocfs2 by filesystem name; xfs invokes xfs_info via shell pipeline. No physical clone operation or independent content proof in this probe.
Xfs command embeds mountpoint in single quotes without escaping embedded apostrophe. This is a construction defect from source, not executed or used against external system.
reflinkfs_table stores wrap_entry->type pointer, but mount_list_close frees that string. Later use of table values requires review before asserting reachable stale dereference.
Unknown devices grouped under disk0 with rotational assumption, while blkid failure branch treats device nonrotational. These are locality heuristics, not file identity validation.
Network filesystem server marker creates synthetic disk identifier; mapping must not be interpreted as unique file-content identity.
Mount iteration returns to beginning when current NULL on next call; code uses this to scan list twice. Not inherently termination bug in inspected loops.
limits: utilities.c only1-1000 read; remaining API/FIEMAP content still to inspect.
No runtime tests, mount commands or rrrah edits. Native pHash deferred; global count150/500.
